questions.q: The variance of the mean of N independent samples with variance σ²:
questions.explain: Averaging 100 samples reduces σ by a factor of 10.

questions.q: The fraction of Gaussian samples outside ±3σ:
questions.explain: 68/95/99.7 — that is where the innovation gates come from.

questions.q: Optimal fusion of z₁ (σ₁) and z₂ (σ₂) weights them by:
options: Variances — the accurate sensor gets less weight

questions.q: After fusing two measurements, the σ of the result is:
options: Smaller than the smaller of σ₁, σ₂
The arithmetic mean of the two σ

questions.q: An off-diagonal element of the covariance matrix shows:
options: How the errors of two components are linked
The variance of the second component
questions.explain: ρ = P₁₂/(σ₁σ₂); geometrically — the tilt of the ellipse.

questions.q: The covariance after a linear transform y = A·x:
questions.explain: The same formula is the EKF prediction (A = F) and the rotation of the ellipse (A = R).

questions.q: On an Allan deviation plot, a slope of −½ corresponds to:
questions.explain: The plateau is bias instability, +½ is rate random walk.

questions.q: The position error from an accelerometer alone, with no corrections, grows as:
questions.explain: White acceleration noise → velocity √t → position t^1.5.
